title: question pages continue back no sliders
rule: Question pages: Continue (not “Submit” jargon); Back link; don’t use range sliders.
pass_when: Question page primary is Continue (not Submit); a Back link is present; no range slider for the answer.
fail_when: Submit jargon on a question page; no Back; or a range slider as the answer control.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Fluent multistep “Next not Continue” as a winner — dual-cite by surface (question page vs multistep settings). Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.copy.verbs_for_actions`.
